title: Add price list with weight-based pricing for spice products

requirements.summary: Add specific pricing for each weight option on the Shop page with prominent price display next to size selection
acceptanceCriteria: Each product card displays the price for the currently selected weight
Red Chilli shows ₹35, ₹70, or ₹175 based on selected size
Turmeric shows ₹35, ₹70, or ₹175 based on selected size
Coriander shows ₹25, ₹50, or ₹125 based on selected size
Price updates immediately when user selects a different weight option

file_operations.description: Add weight-based pricing data structure for each product (Red Chilli: 100g=₹35, 200g=₹70, 500g=₹175; Turmeric: 100g=₹35, 200g=₹70, 500g=₹175; Coriander: 100g=₹25, 200g=₹50, 500g=₹125). Update the product card UI to display the price prominently below or next to the size selection buttons. Ensure price updates reactively when selectedSize state changes for each product.

requirements.summary: Replace 'Add to Cart' button with 'Buy Now' button that opens a form to collect customer details
acceptanceCriteria: Each product card has a 'Buy Now' button instead of 'Add to Cart'
Clicking 'Buy Now' opens a form or modal
Form includes fields for customer name, address, and weight selection
Weight field is pre-filled with the currently selected weight from the product card
Form validates that all required fields are filled before submission

file_operations.description: Replace the 'Add to Cart' button with a 'Buy Now' button on each product card. Add a Dialog component (from shadcn/ui) that opens when 'Buy Now' is clicked. The dialog should contain a form with fields for customer name (text input), customer address (textarea), and weight selection (pre-filled with currently selected weight from the product card). Include form validation to ensure all fields are required. Pass the product name and current price to the modal state when opening. Verify the shadcn/ui Dialog component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Connect the 'Buy Now' form submission to the backend order storage method and display success confirmation
acceptanceCriteria: Form submission triggers a call to the backend order storage method
All form data (product, weight, price, customer name, address) is sent to backend
User sees a success message after order is stored successfully
Form is cleared or modal is closed after successful submission
Error handling displays appropriate message if backend call fails

file_operations.description: Add a React Query mutation hook `useSubmitOrder` that calls the backend `submitOrder` method. The hook should accept OrderInput parameters (customerName, productName, selectedWeight, address, price) and return the orderId on success. Include error handling and loading states. Use the useActor hook to get the backend actor instance.

Import and use the `useSubmitOrder` mutation hook from useQueries.ts. On form submission in the Buy Now dialog, call the mutation with the collected form data (product name, selected weight, price from state, customer name and address from form inputs). Convert the price to bigint format before sending. Display a success message when the order is submitted successfully using a toast notification or alert. Close the dialog and reset the form after successful submission. Show an error message if the submission fails. Add loading state to disable the submit button during the API call.
